name: codex-attachment-manager
description: Context Attachment Manager for Claude Code: earlier images go out as short placeholders instead of being sent again with every message, and the model fetches the original back by its ID.

plugins.name: codex-attachment-manager
plugins.description: In Claude Code sessions with many images or PDFs, earlier images and PDFs go out as short placeholders instead of being sent again with every message; the model fetches the original, or the pages it needs, back by its ID, also after compaction, and the prompt cache keeps working.
